name: Arcadia
source:
Overexploitation of planet resources causes natural counterattack - seawater lever rises, climate deteriorates, and majority of alive species die with humanity being next in queue. Mankind hurriedly develops space colonization plans and sends a mission to planet Arcadia. Humanity rebuilds there to the best of its ability. 
Main character is an ordinary high school teacher. But he meets a boy who bears a mysterious secret able to change the fate of the world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
过度开采行星资源引发了大自然的反击：海平面上升，气候恶化，大多数生物灭绝，人类也即将步其后尘。人类匆忙制定太空殖民计划，向阿卡迪亚星派出远征队。人类在那里竭尽所能重建文明。
主角是一名普通的高中教师。但他遇到一个身负神秘秘密的男孩，而这个秘密足以改变世界的命运。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
